_comment: Copy this file to supabase_config.json and fill in the two values from your Supabase dashboard: Project Settings -> API. Only the publishable anon key belongs here. NEVER put the service_role key in this file - the app does not need it, and this folder syncs to OneDrive.
_offline_fallback: true = if Supabase cannot be reached, accept the password cached locally at the last successful sign-in, so the office is not locked out when the internet is down. false = require Supabase every single time.
